title: Teddy bear seen from the front across a low sink, rubbing its soapy paws by the running tap in the mint bathroom
model: Google Gemini image generation (via Antigravity CLI, image-generator subagent)
prompt: Soft watercolor and gouache children's picture-book illustration, delicate colored-pencil outlines, warm cream paper texture, gentle pastel palette. The scene is set in a real, cozy room of a family home with a floor, walls and a few homely details (plants, a small shelf), like a warm picture-book interior. Clear contrast and rich, saturated colors with defined darker outlines and shadows, not pale or washed out. No clouds, nothing floating. Cute and friendly, for a 4-year-old. Gender-neutral. Everything painted in one consistent watercolor style, no flat vector shapes, no text, no letters, no logos, no brands, no flags, no recognizable existing characters; every character is original. Square 1:1 composition, main subject large and centered, readable at 4 cm size. The same cute brown teddy bear as the BEAR reference, WITHOUT a nightcap, with small solid black round button eyes (no white of the eye) and a happy smile; exactly two arms and two legs. Seen from the front across the white sink, the whole upper body of the bear is visible behind a low child-height sink (no stool, no steps) in the cozy mint bathroom of the ROOM reference. Its face is fully visible above the tap and not covered by the water. It holds its two round, soft, fingerless teddy-bear paws (plush paws like the BEAR reference, no fingers, no human hands) together under the running water in front of its tummy, with soft white soap foam on the paws, and looks down at them happily; a bar of soap on a little dish on the sink edge and a striped towel hanging beside it. Exactly two arms, both attached to the bear. No toothbrush, no cup. The bear washing its paws is the clear main subject. No people, no human hands, no other characters, no tooth character.
